verdict.rationale: Trigger.dev ships AI-specific primitives — a durable `chat.agent` task type for long-lived AI conversations and code-defined, versioned prompt templates — showing first-class support for agent/LLM steps inside workflows. However, the evidence never explicitly documents model-selection APIs or built-in tool-use/function-calling configuration; tasks are plain async functions, so any model choice or tool orchestration would be hand-rolled by the developer rather than a documented product feature. Missing for 10: explicit docs on selecting/switching LLM providers or models, and explicit tool-use/function-calling support within `chat.agent` or prompt features.
